BACKGROUND_TEXTURE: Specify a 360-degree image for Cubemap mode, or a 2D image for Image mode.
SCREEN_USESPOUT: Enables video output to OBS via Spout. While active, the app screen will stop updating.
PROJECT_SELECTEDCAMERAPREVIEWINTERVAL: Refresh interval (ms) for the selected camera's preview on the remote app's camera page. Lower is smoother but increases load.
PROJECT_UNSELECTEDCAMERAPREVIEWINTERVAL: Interval (ms) between updates of the other cameras' previews. They are refreshed one at a time in turn, so a lower value speeds up the rotation but increases load.
PROJECT_REALTIMEPROPERTYINTERVAL: Interval (ms) at which the remote app polls the values of the properties shown on the active page to follow Studio-side changes. Lower is more responsive but increases load.
AVATAR_VRMMODELFILEPATH_HELP: For VRM, a model with Perfect Sync support is recommended. Without it, mouth movements will fall back to the 'aa' blend shape.
AVATAR_RESETPHYSICS_HELP: Resets physics bones that are stuck or in an unnatural position.
AVATAR_SELECT_HELP: Select an avatar from the list registered in the Asset Manager. Choose "None" to return to the default avatar.
AVATAR_SELECTEDPREFAB_HELP: Select an avatar from the registered prefab list. Selecting will replace the current avatar.
GLTF_MODELFILEPATH_HELP: Path to a .gltf or .glb file to load. Changes take effect immediately.
AVATAR_LOCKLOWERBODYPOSE_HELP: Locks the lower-body position. The avatar is pinned to its anchor position. Individual bone rotations still follow the motion capture, so the pose keeps moving while the avatar stays put.
INPUT_ACTION_REBIND_HELP: Press the button, then press the key or button you want to assign. The new key appears here once it lands.
FRAME_RECORDER_KEYFRAMEINTERVAL: Frames between keyframes. Only affects how far a seek walks back for the shape of the world; values are complete on every frame either way. 60 is once a second at 60fps.
SECTION_FRAME_RECORD_SUBTITLE: Capture a take of live data
